provenance.detail: Every team, player and coach is invented, and every match is generated by the in-repo simulator on the announced VCT 2027 calendar. Formats Riot has not published are marked as assumed. Real pro data needs rights that have not been granted, so none is used and nothing is scraped. Points are recomputed from the raw kill timeline before they are published.
